title.narrative: Pathways to Healing: A Survivor Centred Approach to Address Violence and Human Rights Violations in Bangladesh

description.narrative: Contract related to: Pathways to Healing: A Survivor Centred Approach to Address Violence and Human Rights Violations in Bangladesh - The proposed 18-month exceptional assistance measure seeks to address the urgent needs of approximately 5 000 individuals severely affected by the crisis thereby supporting peace and stabilisation of the country. The measure will reduce the risk of further violence, including electoral violence, foster healing and reconciliation, and contribute to the restoration of trust between the population and the state by providing healthcare, medical and psychosocial support, livelihood assistance, and capacity building to individuals severely affected by the crisis in Bangladesh. The proposed activities will focus on providing medical care and rehabilitation for injured individuals, and strengthening local healthcare capacities; offering mental health and psychosocial support services; and fostering social cohesion through dialogue between civil society actors including minority groups, religious, political and community leaders, government officials, the Election Commission and law enforcement agencies ; and enhancing economic and social resilience of the population by providing skill training and livelihood support to promote income generation.
